overall_explanation: The guard owns the complete meta-path chain, returns None for genuine absence, and leaves ordinary imports to raise ModuleNotFoundError. Chain checks prevent fallback after insertion or mutation, and ordinary context exit restores the original chain identity before reporting a mutation. Cache invalidation now delegates to PathFinder with chain and deadline checks before and after, preserving generated-helper discovery. No actionable defects were identified in the supplied V4 scope. This assessment is source-only; no tests or runtime imports were executed.
